name: ROPES: Reasoning Over Paragraph Effects in Situations
description: ROPES (Reasoning Over Paragraph Effects in Situations) is a reading comprehension benchmark comprising 14,322 questions over 588 background science passages selected by annotators. It tests a system's ability to apply causal effects learned from an expository background text to a new, hypothetical situation.

source_references.notes: Published in Proceedings of the 2nd Workshop on Machine Reading for Question Answering (MRQA 2019), pages 58-62.
